heroBattle: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: sprite sheet for existing Dark Fantasy RPG battle, transparent background. Use the provided approved hero as the EXACT character design: young serious dark-haired male, elaborate black plate armor, burgundy cape, armored boots, same proportions, palette and crisp detailed pixel rendering. Make a regular grid of FOUR COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, twelve FULL BODY frames, generous transparent margins so even sword tips fit. Face RIGHT in three-quarter side battle stance in EVERY frame. Row1: FOUR subtly DIFFERENT breathing battle idle poses, sword held ready, small cape/arm/chest movement, no foot translation. Rows2 and3 together: EIGHT sequential SWORD ATTACK poses, row-major order: ready, pull sword back, raise and coil, begin slash, IMPACT sword extended forward right, follow-through, recover, return to exactly ready stance. Leg bracing and torso/arms rotate naturally; a real articulated strike, not shifting a static drawing. Keep sword attached to the same hand, consistent armor/hair/face/cape in all frames. No shield. One ordinary steel sword, no glow/trails/VFX. Align root/body axis and boot baseline, identical character scale, equal cell canvases about512x640, output approx2048x1920; accurate unclipped silhouettes are more important than exact overall size. No captions, grid lines, backgrounds, shadows, cinematic motion blur, smooth painterly surfaces, extra characters or duplicated near-identical attack poses. Crisp pixel style harmonious with reference.
skeletonBattle: Asset: animated battle sprite sheet for a Dark Fantasy top-down RPG, TRANSPARENT. Reference1 is the existing Skeleton enemy design: skull and bones, worn rusty dark armor, burgundy cloth, simple steel sword and shield. Reference2 approved hero sets detailed crisp pixel art quality, palette, lighting and human-scale proportions. Render Skeleton as menacing anatomically skeletal undead, NOT cute/cartoon/chibi. No skin/hair, hollow dark eyes, dirty ivory bones, rusty armor. Face RIGHT in a three-quarter battle view in every pose. FOUR COLUMNS by FIVE ROWS regular grid with generous transparent margins, approximate2048x2400. Row1 FOUR DIFFERENT subtle animated battle idle poses: head/chest/hands/shield shift lightly, boots stay grounded. Rows2 and3 EIGHT consecutive one-handed SWORD ATTACK poses: ready, windup, coil, begin slash, IMPACT fully extended forward-right, follow-through, recover, ready. Keep shield in opposite hand, blade attached to sword hand and all joints anatomically coherent. Row4: first TWO frames hit reaction Hurt (brace then recoil), last TWO frames Death (buckling knees then collapsing). Row5 first TWO frames final Death (fall to ground then settled bones/armor/sword/shield heap), last two cells EMPTY transparent. Total eighteen character frames. Same sprite scale, root/body axis and boot baseline through idle/attack/hurt. Death settles on same groundline. No ground, labels, grid lines, shadows, backgrounds, weapon trails or external VFX, blur or smooth painterly rendering. All sword tips and cape/cloth fully inside generous cell margins. Real pose changes, not translating a static drawing.
